subject: Approval: H100 reservation + guardrails for FP8/INT8 benchmark sprint (ENG-7421)
related_links: Confluence: FP8 benchmark fleet reservation plan
body:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 8:14 AM
Subject: Approval: H100 reservation + guardrails for FP8/INT8 benchmark sprint (ENG-7421)

Neha,

Requesting approval to reserve additional H100 capacity for the FP8/INT8 kernel benchmarking sprint (ENG-7421). We’re trying to avoid piecemeal reservations and instead lock a predictable window so the matrix runner can complete without fighting production contention.

What we’re asking for:
- H100 (80GB) reservation across 2 clusters for a 10–12 day window
- Target: ~3,200–3,800 GPU-hours total (depending on reruns for variance)
- Regions: us-east + us-west (benchmark clusters only)
- Constraint: no impact to Dedicated / customer isolation pools

Vanessa has the cost breakdown + proposed guardrails (cc’d). If approved today, we can start staging the capacity by tomorrow morning and unblock the runners.

Thanks,
Irene

—
Irene Choi
GPU Fleet Provisioning Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: fp8-benchmark-fleet-reservation-plan.pdf


---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 8:32 AM
Subject: Re: Approval: H100 reservation + guardrails for FP8/INT8 benchmark sprint (ENG-7421)

Adding numbers + guardrails detail.

Cost / hours (estimate):
- H100 80GB on benchmark clusters: 3,600 GPU-hours
- Effective blended rate (incl. reserved overhead): $7.80/hr
- Total estimated spend: ~$28k
- Buffer: +15% hours for variance reruns (only if needed)

Proposed guardrails (to avoid customer impact):
1) Hard separation: use benchmark clusters only (no Dedicated pools, no shared “burst” pools used for customer SLA).
2) Time windows: schedule heavy runs 7pm–7am local cluster time; daytime only for calibration / short microbench.
3) Admission control: enforce a max cap of 80% allocatable H100s on those clusters for benchmark jobs; leave 20% headroom.
4) Labeling + quotas: require runner jobs tagged "bench_sprint_fp8int8" + quota-limited namespace.
5) Kill switch: if we see production spillover or node pressure, we immediately pause runner queue (Vanessa/Irene can do this without waiting for Runtime).

If you approve, we’ll finalize the reservation in the capacity system and reply back with the exact node pools + IDs.

-V

Attachment: h100-reservation-asks-and-costs.xlsx


---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 9:05 AM
Subject: Re: Approval: H100 reservation + guardrails for FP8/INT8 benchmark sprint (ENG-7421)

Approved for up to $30k for this sprint (including the +15% rerun buffer). Please proceed with the reservation.

Conditions / guardrails (non-negotiable):
- Zero Dedicated pool impact: benchmarks must not run on Dedicated-capable pools or any pool that can be dynamically borrowed for customer traffic.
- Enforce admission control: keep headroom and treat 80% as a hard ceiling; do not “temporarily” increase without explicit approval.
- Time windows: keep the majority of the work in the 7pm–7am window unless you confirm there’s no overlap with other internal load.
- Monitoring + comms: post the reservation IDs + schedule in #eng-infra and #eng-runtime. If any abnormal contention shows up, pause first and notify.

Also: please link this thread to the internal quota/helpdesk ticket (INT-9923) so we have an audit trail for the spend.

Neha

—
Neha Kapoor
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference


---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 10:18 AM
Subject: Re: Approval: H100 reservation + guardrails for FP8/INT8 benchmark sprint (ENG-7421)

Thanks — acknowledged on all guardrails.

Next steps we’re executing today:
- Reserve H100s on benchmark clusters only (us-east-bench-02 + us-west-bench-01)
- Configure namespace quota + required job label: bench_sprint_fp8int8
- Set max allocatable for benchmarks to 80% capacity (hard cap)
- Publish the schedule + reservation IDs in #eng-infra / #eng-runtime once the reservation is active

We’ll add the INT-9923 link + approval note in the ticket comments.

Irene

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 12:41 PM
Subject: Re: Approval: H100 reservation + guardrails for FP8/INT8 benchmark sprint (ENG-7421)

Reservation is now staged on both clusters. Admission control + label requirement is in place.

Reservation summary:
- us-east-bench-02: 48x H100 (80GB) nightly window reserved
- us-west-bench-01: 32x H100 (80GB) nightly window reserved
- Headroom preserved per Neha’s 80% cap

I’ll post IDs + the exact window in Slack (and include the pause/kill procedure).

Vanessa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Perfect. Please ensure the Slack post includes:
- Start/end dates for the reservation
- The hard cap reminder (80% ceiling)

If Runtime requests an extension, route it back through this thread with an updated cost estimate before making changes.

Neha
